title: Terminal Tanks - a turn-based artillery game. Set your angle and power, read the wind, and fire. It started as a terminal game and now runs in the browser and on a real Nintendo DS too.
author: ethanlabs101
selftext:
What's in it:

\- 123 tanks and 123 ammo types

\- 147 battlefields and 100 home screens

\- 33 bosses, 20 tournament levels, 50 missions

\- 218 workshop parts to build your own tank, 12 animated paints

\- 514 unlockables and 24 cheat codes

\- 277 songs, all generated in code

\- 21,000+ lines of pure Python, zero dependencies



2 player local, LAN on PC, and DS-to-DS wireless.



I designed it, tested it and directed it; AI wrote most of the code.



Play in the browser or grab the DS version: [https://ethanlabs101.github.io/terminaltanks-site/](https://ethanlabs101.github.io/terminaltanks-site/)

  
Would love to hear what you think if you give it a try.
